title: Recorded test run
responsibility: Displays one side of grouped test outcomes and their artifacts.

inputs.name: EntityRun.shown
inputs.description: Contains the scenarios and grouped before/after results rendered in the pane. The overall verdict passes only when at least one group exists and every group has a passed outcome for the selected side; scenario titles fall back to their ids.

inputs.name: EntityRun.side
inputs.description: Selects each group's and result line's before or after outcome. Difference paths are shown only for the after side.

inputs.name: EntityRun.title
inputs.description: Text shown as the pane heading and used as its accessible section name.

inputs.name: EntityRun.role
inputs.description: Text shown in the side badge next to the title. It does not select a result side or change the verdict.

inputs.name: EntityRun.mediaBase
inputs.description: String prefix concatenated with a recorded media path to form an artifact link when a capture has media. It is passed through without normalization.

inputs.name: EntityRun.lost
inputs.description: Optional flag forwarded to artifact views; when true, an unread result is shown as not verified instead of remaining in the reading state. Defaults to false.

inputs.name: EntityRun.unit
inputs.description: Optional function unit id forwarded to artifact rows; when supplied, those rows are treated as callable and show only that unit's calls. When omitted, its value is undefined.

outputs.name: EntityRun
outputs.description: Renders a pane headed by title with a verdict based only on a nonempty groups array whose selected-side outcomes all pass, plus one state section per group. It shows each result's kind and selected-side status, adds difference paths only for after, and delegates artifact rendering and links to EntityArtifact.
